scripts.dry-run: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "full_cleanup", "dryRun": true}}' | jq
scripts.full: npm run build && npm run start:dev
scripts.analyze: npm run start:dev & sleep 3 && npm run dry-run:dev && read -p 'Запустить очистку? (y/N): ' confirm && [[ $confirm == [yY] ]] && npm run cleanup:dev
scripts.reset: docker stop $(docker ps -q) 2>/dev/null && docker container prune -f
